content_text: Of all the wheelchair dollies I built on no-budget shoots, my favorite set up that surprisingly worked was sitting in the wheelchair on a hardwood floor, wearing thick socks with the camera nestled on my feet sliding along the hallway, for an eye-level, low angle view of our mortally wounded protagonist crawling away from his assailant.
